After walking through a glass hallway and on an escalator, she is then greeted by a young man who hands her a bag of baby carrots. He wears a light-wash jean jacket and a striped T-shirt. Finally, the woman sees two girls who excitedly meet her at the airport; all three girls excitedly share the camera and proclaim, "Go Ottawa!" A young man is then seen, also wearing a light-wash jean jacket, exiting the terminal; she asks him if he is lost.
